name: Odoo
summary: Open-source business apps, including CRM and ERP.

flows.title: Start a quotation from an opportunity
steps: Open the CRM app, which opens the Pipeline page on the main CRM dashboard.
Click the opportunity you want, then read what is there and update any field that needs it.
If a quotation has already been drawn up for this opportunity, it can be found by clicking the Quotations smart button at the top of the form.
At the top-left of the form, click the New Quotation button. That button appears only where the Sales application is installed.
